definition: A waxy substance formed inside sperm whales and used in perfumes.
author: Herman Melville
quote: Sounding him carefully, Stubb further perceived that the Guernsey-man had not the slightest suspicion concerning the ambergris.
example_sentence: Some old perfumes were made with ambergris from whales.
